newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends up on intermarket spreading.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends up on intermarket spreading.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled higher as commercial firms bought the Minneapolis/Kansas City intermarket spread, traders said.

"All the commercials up here were roaring about buying Minnepolis, selling Kansas City because of the imminent (hard red winter wheat) harvest. I guess the feeling was that we were too cheap relative to (KCBT wheat)," a MGE trader said.
Traders said MGE spring wheat drew spillover support from closing strength in CBOT soybeans. There was also an overall lack of hedge selling in the MGE spring wheat pit, traders said.
Traders said they had also seen some short-covering at the open, which likely came in response to Thursday's late break.
MGE spring wheat settled three to 7-1/4 cents per bushel higher, with July up 7-1/4 cents at $3.90-3/4. New crop September gained 5-1/4 cents to close at $3.86.
